author: michaelkrymski
summary: Preserve concurrent PM refresh and make lock test opt-in
details: Normal merge retains both remote accepted-main refresh and local lifecycle/clock work after rejected non-fast-forward push. Assisted lock test requires explicit runner flag so unattended suites do not wait for operator.
validation: First clock checkpoint passed 250 shared tests; actual prior lock result retained and attributed before selection guard. Fresh checked publication required.
